tasks.label: Deploy to ION
args: if [[ "${file}" == *"Document flow"* ]]; then node "${workspaceFolder}/dist/cli.js" deploy --file "${file}" --with-dependencies --sync-dependencies; else node "${workspaceFolder}/dist/cli.js" deploy --file "${file}"; fi

tasks.label: Deploy to ION (Dry Run)
args: if [[ "${file}" == *"Document flow"* ]]; then node "${workspaceFolder}/dist/cli.js" deploy --file "${file}" --with-dependencies --sync-dependencies --dry-run; else node "${workspaceFolder}/dist/cli.js" deploy --file "${file}" --dry-run; fi
